# A signed right shift of int64 elements needs Int64s.ShiftAllRight, which the
# release toolchain's simd does not have, so the loop is left alone there. A
# development toolchain has it, and it shifts arithmetically as Go's >> does, for
# negative numbers and for counts at and past the element width.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
[!tip] loopvec -split .
[!tip] ! stdout .
[!tip] ! stderr .
[!tip] ! exists ops_simd.go
[!tip] cmp ops.go ops.go.orig
[!tip] stop 'the release toolchain has no 64-bit signed right shift'

loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Shr64Const(dst, a []int64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] >> 2
	}
}

func Shr64Var(dst, a []int64, n uint) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] >> n
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func Shr64Const(dst, a []int64) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] >> 2
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt64sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.ShiftAllRight(uint64(2)).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func Shr64Var(dst, a []int64, n uint) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] >> n
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt64sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.ShiftAllRight(uint64(n)).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	s := []int64{0, 1, -1, -8, 100, -100, -1 << 63, 1<<63 - 1, -12345678901234567, 5}
	out := make([]int64, len(s))
	test.Shr64Const(out, s)
	fmt.Println(out)
	for _, n := range []uint{0, 1, 2, 62, 63, 64, 65, 200, 1 << 40} {
		test.Shr64Var(out, s, n)
		fmt.Println(n, out)
	}
}
